fusions.name: Antlered Spin
fusions.desc: Spins the axe low, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Startled Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you throw it.

fusions.name: Spring Clear
fusions.desc: A bound that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 2 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Struck First
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
